## Checklist

- [ ] `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, and `go test ./...` pass
- [ ] `gofmt -l .` prints nothing
- [ ] `golangci-lint run ./...` reports no issues
- [ ] `govulncheck ./...` reports no new vulnerabilities
- [ ] New exported identifiers have doc comments
- [ ] Comments added are doc-only (behavior/contract), not rationale or planning context — see
      [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#code-style)
